subject.title: fix(ui): render pinned sessions headerless like sidebar nav entries

question: Should pinned sessions intentionally become always-visible, headerless navigation entries for existing users, including users with a persisted collapsed pinned section?
rationale: The patch is mechanically small and visually proven, but it deliberately changes a persisted sidebar interaction rather than only removing decorative chrome.

options.title: Accept headerless pinned entries
options.body: Treat pinned sessions as always-visible shortcuts and accept that the old per-section collapse preference no longer applies.

options.title: Preserve collapsibility
options.body: Keep a visible or otherwise discoverable collapse control if retaining existing pinned-section preference behavior is more important than matching navigation rows.

recommendation.title: Accept headerless pinned entries
recommendation.body: Treat pinned sessions as always-visible shortcuts and accept that the old per-section collapse preference no longer applies.

likelyOwner.reason: Available release provenance makes steipete the best-supported routing contact, though direct ownership of this helper was not established.
